content.text:
<user_query>
hey this is my documentation website. I have run into an issue when deploying however... [MkDocs strict-mode build failing with 14 warnings: broken links in ai-usage.md and adr-003-hosting-topology.md, pages not in nav configuration]
</user_query>

Analyzed all 14 warnings from the strict-mode build. Identified four categories of issues:

1. **Broken links in ai-usage.md**: wrong folder name (`ai-transcripts` vs actual `ai_transcripts`), missing `.txt` extension on one link, references to non-existent `OwenPace_01.txt`, and wrong filename on the cloudflare deploy transcript.
2. **Broken links in adr-003-hosting-topology.md**: 11 links referencing files outside the docs directory (`../../README.md`, `../../render.yaml`, `../../apps/api/src/main.ts`, etc.) that don't exist in this documentation-only repo.
3. **Filename case mismatch**: file on disk was `ADR-003-hosting-topology.md` (uppercase) but nav referenced `adr-003-hosting-topology.md` (lowercase).
4. **Nav warnings**: `meetings/_template.md` and `meetings/how-to-summarize.md` not included in nav configuration.

Applied fixes:
- `docs/ai-usage.md`: Fixed transcript links — changed non-existent `OwenPace_01.txt` references to "Not yet provided", added missing `.txt` extension, corrected folder name and filename for cloudflare deploy transcript.
- `docs/decisions/adr-003-hosting-topology.md`: Converted all 11 out-of-repo markdown links to plain `code` references.
- Renamed `ADR-003-hosting-topology.md` → `adr-003-hosting-topology.md` (lowercase).
- `mkdocs.yml`: Added `_template.md` and `how-to-summarize.md` to the Meetings nav section.

Verified locally with `mkdocs build --strict` — exit code 0, zero warnings.

<user_query>
okay now commit this and make a ai usage row of yourself (qoder lite) and add yourself as a transcript to the ai-transcripts folder.
</user_query>

Added a new row to the AI Usage Ledger for this session (2026-08-21, Qoder Lite) documenting the broken-links fix, and created the corresponding JSONL transcript file at `docs/transcripts/ai_transcripts/2026-08-21-adrian-qoder-fix-broken-links.jsonl`. Ready to commit all changes.
